It claims to be a market leader in edible salt in India and was also the countrys first national branded iodised white salt. 3. Prior to the introduction of TATA Salt, non-iodised salt was being consumed in India and at that time, it was found that a large mass of the population suffered from ailments due to iodine deficiency. The Plaintiff thus commenced manufacture of iodine salt. It was the first iodine fortified salt manufactured and sold in bulk quantity to eliminate ailments relating to iodine deficiency.
